Nina (People Ops): Quick heads-up: Jordan turned in notice today, last day 2025-09-03. Need to confirm benefits cutoff, COBRA timing, badge return, and access removal. Carlos can you draft deprovision timing?
Carlos (IT): Yep. Do we want Slack suspended same day after hours or next morning? Also, laptop return options?
Priya (Eng Manager): Keep Slack until end of last day so Jordan can finish handoffs. Laptop can be dropped at reception next day.
Jordan (Ops): I'll prepare a 1-pager handoff and list of active runbooks by 08/29. Happy with 30-day email forwarding.
BenefitsBot: Benefits coverage end date: 2025-09-30. COBRA packet to be sent within 14 days after termination processed.
Nina (People Ops): Jordan, exit interview options: 2025-09-07 10am PT (30m) or 09-08 2pm PT (30m). Which works?
Jordan (Ops): 09-07 10am works. Thanks.
Carlos (IT): Proposed deprovision plan:
- 2025-09-03 17:00 UTC: suspend Okta (no interactive login)
- 2025-09-04 09:00 UTC: disable Slack + revoke tokens
- 2025-09-04 10:00 UTC: remove GitHub org membership; rotate any deploy keys linked to user
- 2025-09-04 11:00 UTC: revoke AWS keys and remove IAM access
- 2025-09-04: collect laptop at reception and image device
I'll open ticket IT-5012 and tag Priya for approvals.
Priya (Eng Manager): Approved. Please ensure any scheduled alerts owned by Jordan are reassigned to oncall.
Nina (People Ops): Action items recap: Jordan: handoff doc by 08/29; Carlos: create IT-5012 and run deprovision; Benefits: send COBRA + payroll loop; Priya: reassign runbooks. I'll send calendar invites for exit interview. :wave:
Jordan (Ops): Thanks everyone. Appreciate the smooth process.
